name: lithicanalyst
description: Open-source 3D annotation and measurement of lithic artefacts, in one HTML file that runs offline in the browser: flake scar directions, curves, surface regions, relations and sequences, landmarks and semilandmarks, measurements, figures and inter-observer comparison, with exports for R.

scripts.pages: npm run build && rolldown scripts/pages.ts --platform node --format esm --file node_modules/.cache/lithicanalyst-pages.mjs && node node_modules/.cache/lithicanalyst-pages.mjs
scripts.e2e: tsc --noEmit -p e2e && npm run build && playwright test
scripts.i18n: rolldown scripts/i18n.ts --platform node --format esm --external typescript --file node_modules/.cache/lithicanalyst-i18n.mjs && node node_modules/.cache/lithicanalyst-i18n.mjs
